_readme: Hand-curated (LLM-assigned, human-reviewable) ingredient category taxonomy for the new corpus. Keyed by algorithmic head (see extract_ingredient_heads.py / ingredient_heads_ranked.json). Each entry is one of: (1) a plain {category_path: [...]} applying to every ingredient name under that head; (2) {rules: [{contains_any: [...], category_path: [...]}], default_category_path: [...]} for heads whose head word alone doesn't determine category (e.g. 'pepper' spans both a spice and a vegetable), rules evaluated in order against the lowercased ingredient name, first match wins, default_category_path used if none match; (3) {alias_of: '<other head>'} for a head that is not itself a real ingredient identity -- typically a non-noun form (participle/adjective) of another head's ingredient, e.g. 'juiced' aliasing 'juice' ('lemon, juiced' and 'lemon juice' are the same ingredient). Resolvers must follow alias_of before applying rules. Excluded heads (parser artifacts, not real ingredients at all) are marked explicitly with excluded:true rather than omitted, so it's clear they were considered.

as.reason: Parser artifact from '...or as needed' trailing clauses, not an ingredient. See NEW_CORPUS_DATA_QUALITY.md addendum.

more.reason: Parser artifact from '...or more' trailing clauses, not an ingredient. See NEW_CORPUS_DATA_QUALITY.md addendum.

if.reason: Parser artifact from '...or more if needed' trailing clauses, not an ingredient. See NEW_CORPUS_DATA_QUALITY.md addendum.

pepper.note: Head 'pepper' spans black/white/cayenne peppercorn (spice) and bell/chili peppers (vegetable) -- genuinely different foods sharing one string head.

oil.note: Not split by variety (olive/vegetable/sesame/...) -- existing head-matching already resolves these correctly within one head; splitting adds no matching value here.

powder.note: Grab-bag head: baking powder (leavening) vs spice powders (garlic/onion/chili/curry) vs cocoa powder (baking) are unrelated foods.

extract.note: Split by flavor deliberately, unlike 'oil' -- extract flavors are not interchangeable in a recipe, so collapsing them to one leaf would be a real precision loss if this ever backs matching.

broth.note: IngredientMatcher already correctly keeps 'chicken broth' from matching fridge 'chicken' (different head noun) -- this taxonomy entry doesn't change that, it's purely additive for category-based browsing/matching.

chicken.note: Cuts (breast/thigh/wing/whole) already unify under this head via PART_WORDS, so no 3rd level needed for the cuts seen in this batch. Known separate gap: 'chicken tender(s)' -- head 'tender', not 'chicken', since 'tender' isn't in PART_WORDS. Route any 'tender'-headed entries here when encountered.

beef.note: Base node for the cross-head beef unification -- steak/ribeye/chuck/ground-beef-headed entries (different string heads) get routed here too as they're encountered further down the list.

mix.note: Heavy grab-bag head -- taco/cake/soup/pudding/coleslaw/dressing mixes are unrelated products that only share the word 'mix'.

cube.note: 'Knorr cubes'/'bouillon cubes' route to the same Bouillon nodes as the 'bouillon' head below.

wine.note: Not split red/white -- head-matching already handles this fine within one head, same reasoning as 'oil'.

chunk.note: Describes a cut form, not identity -- the real ingredient is embedded in the name (same class of gap as 'juiced'/'frying'), so routed to the base fruit's own category via keyword rules.

stock.note: 'Stock' and 'broth' are functionally interchangeable in recipes -- routed to the same category nodes as the 'broth' head (batch 1) rather than a parallel 'Stock' tree.

clove.note: Whole clove the spice -- garlic cloves are already stripped to head 'garlic' via PART_WORDS, so this head only ever sees the spice.

pork.note: Base node for pork-cut cross-head unification (roast/ham/sausage/bacon route here).

inch.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state participle with no single consistent embedded ingredient (unlike 'chunk'/'wedge'/'zest', which do have identifiable referents). Same class as as/more/if: STOPWORDS in IngredientMatcher.kt doesn't include this word, so it survives to become the head. Out of scope to fix there (needs a test-covered Kotlin change, affects the old corpus too) -- excluded here rather than mis-categorized. Here specifically a leaked unit-of-measurement word ('cut into 1-inch pieces'), not even a prep participle.

frying.note: Every example is '[some] oil for frying' -- 'for' is dropped as a RECIPE_ONLY_STOPWORD, leaving 'frying' as the surviving non-part-word, so this is really just oil. Same class of gap as 'juiced'->'juice'.

buttermilk.note: Matches the 'buttermilk' rule already present under the 'milk' head (batch 1) -- same real ingredient, reached directly here since 'buttermilk' is itself a distinct head.

roast.note: Key cross-head unification instance: 'beef chuck roast'/'pork butt roast' would otherwise have no relation to the 'beef'/'pork' heads at all.

steak.note: Key cross-head unification instance: 'flank steak'/'filet mignon'/'flat iron steak' would otherwise have no relation to the 'beef' head at all -- exactly the T-bone/ribeye gap this taxonomy was built to fix.

broken.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state participle with no single consistent embedded ingredient (unlike 'chunk'/'wedge'/'zest', which do have identifiable referents). Same class as as/more/if: STOPWORDS in IngredientMatcher.kt doesn't include this word, so it survives to become the head. Out of scope to fix there (needs a test-covered Kotlin change, affects the old corpus too) -- excluded here rather than mis-categorized.

half.note: All distinct names are 'half-and-half' the dairy product -- matches the rule already in the 'cream' head (batch 1).

roughly.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized.

dusting.note: Describes purpose ('for dusting'), not identity -- same class of gap as juiced/frying, routed to the base ingredient.

round.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. No dominant referent (bread rounds, carrot rounds, onion rounds, citrus rounds all appear).

green.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. Sometimes a color adjective ('apple, red or green'), not a noun at all.

ring.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. Mixes food (pineapple/onion rings) and non-food (canning jar rings).

bonnet.note: 'Scotch bonnet' -- a hot chili pepper variety.

scallion.note: Matches how 'Green Onions' already resolves under the 'onion' head (batch 1) -- kept at the same node rather than adding a 3rd level split the 'onion' head itself doesn't have, for consistency.

cooky.note: Singularize() over-applies its 'ies'->'y' rule to 'cookies' (a plain -s plural, not a true -y/-ies pair like 'party/parties'), yielding head 'cooky'. Another small IngredientMatcher gap, same disposition as as/more/crushed: noted, not fixed here.

lengthwise.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized.

cover.note: 'water to cover' / 'cold water, to cover' -- always water.

bite.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. Pure size descriptor ('bite-sized pieces') applied to many unrelated foods.

prawn.note: Treated as interchangeable with shrimp for matching purposes.

liquid.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. ('with liquid' / 'with the liquid' -- describes canning liquid, not the item itself; embedded ingredient varies too much to route reliably.)

chickpea.note: Matches the garbanzo/chickpea rule already in the 'bean' head (batch 1).

split.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized.

peel.note: 'Peel' and 'zest' are the same concept for citrus -- routed to the same nodes as the 'zest' head where applicable.

adjust.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized.

pie.note: Dominant content is pastry/crust for a pie shell, not the pie as a dish.

washed.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized.

fat.reason: Too ambiguous to route reliably: sometimes an attribute ('fat-free half-and-half'), sometimes a real product ('bacon fat'), sometimes a prep-state ('trimmed of excess fat'). No single rule captures this safely.

cider.note: Kept separate from Produce/Juice/Apple Juice -- 'hard apple cider' is alcoholic, so conflating with juice would be wrong some of the time.

cup.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. A leaked unit-of-measurement word ('strawberries, about 2 cups') -- the real ingredient sits before it and varies too much to route reliably.

foil.reason: Not food -- a kitchen supply (aluminum foil).

choice.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. ('sweetener of choice', 'milk of your choice' -- describes user choice, no fixed referent.)

amino.note: Coconut/liquid aminos are soy-sauce alternatives, routed to the same node.

torn.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized.

chily.note: singularize() misparse of 'chilies' (parallel to 'cooky'/'cookies') -- same real ingredient as the 'chile'/'pepper' heads.

patted.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized.

chestnut.note: Water chestnut is an aquatic vegetable, not a tree nut -- kept separate from the Pantry/Nut/* leaves.

brisket.note: Beef cut (including corned beef brisket) -- cross-head unification instance.

slightly.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized.

preserve.note: Preserves and jam are functionally interchangeable for recipe matching -- routed to the same nodes as the 'jam' head rather than a parallel tree.

essence.note: 'Essence' is the UK-English term for 'extract' -- routed to the same nodes as the 'extract' head.

tender.note: Confirms the gap flagged in batch 1: 'tender' isn't in PART_WORDS (only 'tenderloin' is), so 'chicken tenders' resolves to head 'tender', not 'chicken'. Routed here directly.

tatashe.note: Nigerian-English name for red bell pepper.

substitute.reason: Deliberately NOT aliased to its base ingredient (egg/sugar/cheese/beef substitute), matching IngredientMatcher.kt's own documented design: 'substitute' changes what a thing IS, so 'egg substitute' correctly does NOT match fridge 'egg' today. Aliasing this head would silently undo that existing, intentional behavior.

sirloin.note: Cross-head unification instance, same as steak/roast/brisket.

square.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. No dominant referent (cereal squares, bell pepper squares, cracker squares).

skewer.reason: Not food -- a kitchen tool (wooden/bamboo/metal skewers).

fry.note: Majority of examples are potato fries (French fries, waffle fries); 'stir-fry:' section headers are the minority, accepted imprecision.

mixture.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. Too generic/heterogeneous (bean mixture, curing mixture, fruit mixture).

matchstick.note: Consistently a vegetable cut-form (bell pepper/carrot/cabbage matchsticks), unlike round/ring/bite which mix in non-food or have no dominant referent -- kept as a low-precision generic bucket rather than excluded.

layer.reason: Recipe-structure section header ('pumpkin layer:', 'cheesecake layer:'), not an ingredient.

cocktail.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. Mixed meaning (juice cocktail, fruit cocktail, section header), low value.

food.reason: Head is meaningless on its own ('processed cheese food', 'carrot baby food') -- too generic to route.

coating.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form/meta word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. Purpose descriptor ('flour for coating', 'chocolate coating').

onionchopped.note: Glued-word artifact ('Onion'+'chopped' with no space) -- another instance of the missing-delimiter issue documented in NEW_CORPUS_DATA_QUALITY.md, just under the 40-char blob threshold.

bag.note: Mostly non-food (roasting bag, turkey bag) with one real food signal (tea bags).

toothpick.reason: Not food -- kitchen equipment/container/supply, not an ingredient.

hock.note: Ham hock -- routed to the same node as the 'ham' head.

parmesan.note: Matches the parmesan rule already in the 'cheese' head (batch 1).

ingredient.reason: Recipe-structure meta-word ('dry ingredients', 'remaining ingredients:'), not a food.

rodo.note: 'Ata rodo' -- Yoruba name for scotch bonnet, same as the 'bonnet' head.

short.note: 'Beef short ribs' / 'short ribs' -- always beef. Cross-head unification instance.

o.note: Mostly the trademark symbol surviving from 'Jell-O(R)' (flavored gelatin, routed to the same node as the 'gelatin' head). One stray example is 'jalapeno' -- TOKEN_SEPARATOR is ASCII-only ([^a-z]+), so the accented 'n-with-tilde' splits the word instead of being treated as a letter, a small separate Unicode-handling gap worth knowing about but not fixed here (same disposition as the as/more/crushed/cooky gaps).

each.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form/meta word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. Prep quantifier ('12 slices each'), not an ingredient.

pound.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form/meta word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. Leaked unit-of-measurement word, embedded ingredient varies too much.

very.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form/meta word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. Pure adverb.

paper.reason: Not food -- kitchen equipment/container/supply, not an ingredient. (waxed/parchment paper)

ale.note: 'Ginger ale' is a soft drink, not beer -- routed to the same node as the 'soda' head; other ales are real beer.

ball.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form/meta word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. Shape descriptor with no dominant referent (mozzarella balls, cantaloupe balls, rice balls).

only.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form/meta word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. ('white parts only', 'leaves only').

protein.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form/meta word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. Too generic/heterogeneous (textured vegetable protein, collagen protein powder).

flavor.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form/meta word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. Too generic ('vanilla flavor', 'any flavor') to route safely.

sheet.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form/meta word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. Mixed products (matzo/nori/gelatin/rice paper sheets), low value to split further.

thickly.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form/meta word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. Pure adverb.

atarodo.note: Alternate spelling of 'ata rodo' -- same as 'rodo' head.

garnishing.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form/meta word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. Purpose descriptor, more varied than 'garnish' (citrus/parsley/cinnamon/pecans), no dominant referent.

packet.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form/meta word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. Generic container word (spice packet, seasoning packet, smoothie packet).

teaspoon.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form/meta word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. Leaked unit-of-measurement word, embedded ingredient varies too much.

jelly.note: Functionally interchangeable with jam/preserves -- routed to the same node.

dice.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form/meta word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. Cut-form descriptor, no dominant referent.

pepperto.note: Glued-word artifact ('pepper'+'to [taste]' with no space) -- same class as onionchopped/saltto.

consomme.note: Concentrated beef broth -- routed to the same node as the 'broth' head.

third.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form/meta word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. Leaked fraction/count word ('cut into thirds').

harina.note: Corn flour for tortillas/tamales -- distinct enough from wheat flour to get its own leaf.

section.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form/meta word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. Cut-form descriptor (carrot/celery/yuca sections).

husk.reason: A discarded/wrapping byproduct of corn (used for tamale-wrapping, not eaten as the ingredient content) -- routing it to Produce/Corn would wrongly imply fridge corn kernels satisfy a corn-husk requirement.

serving.reason: Recipe-structure meta-word ('serving:', 'cut into serving pieces'), not a food.

link.note: Sausage links -- matches the 'sausage' head's own chicken/default split.

bowl.reason: Not food -- kitchen equipment/container/supply, not an ingredient. / recipe-structure header ('the bowls:').

jar.reason: Not food -- kitchen equipment/container/supply, not an ingredient. (mason/canning jars)

off.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form/meta word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. ('skin cut off', 'stems cut off').

fresco.note: 'Queso fresco' -- distinct enough cheese variety to get its own leaf.

other.reason: Literally just 'other:' -- a section-header placeholder, meaningless on its own.

pimento.note: 'Pimento' means two different things in this corpus: the jarred sweet pepper AND (in some regional usage) allspice berry -- 2 of 5 examples were actually allspice.

serve.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form/meta word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. Purpose descriptor ('to serve:').

end.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form/meta word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. ('ends trimmed' on green beans/okra/asparagus/mushrooms/eggplant).

crosswise.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form/meta word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. Pure adverb.

color.note: Mostly 'Food Color' (dye) -- routed to the same node as the 'coloring' head. Minor accepted imprecision: 'bell peppers, any color' isn't about dye at all.

cocoa.note: Matches the cocoa rule already in the 'powder' head (batch 1).

rolling.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form/meta word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. Purpose descriptor ('for rolling').

e.note: Another Unicode-tokenizer artifact (like the 'o'/jalapeno case) -- accented chars in 'purée' split oddly under the ASCII-only [^a-z]+ separator. Majority of examples are about purée, routed to the same node as the 'puree' head.

grease.note: 'Bacon grease' -- routed to the same node as the 'dripping' head.

diagonally.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form/meta word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. Pure adverb.

wrap.note: Dominant food meaning is tortilla wraps; 'plastic wrap' (non-food) is a minor accepted imprecision at this usage level (n=12).

soaked.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form/meta word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. Mixes food (oats, quinoa) and non-food (wood chips).

ground.note: 'McCormick(R) Cinnamon, Ground' style entries -- the spice name precedes 'Ground', not the reverse, but head-matching still lands on the trailing word.

preference.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form/meta word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. ('adjust to preference').

onionfinely.note: Glued-word artifact, same class as onionchopped.

skinless.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form/meta word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. Applied to chicken, garlic, and almonds inconsistently -- not reliably about one ingredient.

bitter.note: Cocktail bitters (Angostura, aromatic, cardamom) dominate; one outlier ('bitter leaves', a Nigerian vegetable) is an accepted minor imprecision.

whipped.note: Every example is heavy/whipping cream, whipped.

verde.note: 'Salsa verde' -- routed to the same node as the 'salsa'/'gallo' heads.

cheesecloth.reason: Not food -- kitchen equipment/container/supply, not an ingredient.

overnight.reason: Heterogeneous prep-state/cut-form/meta word with no single consistent embedded ingredient. Same class as as/more/if/thawed/halved/etc. Excluded rather than mis-categorized. Pure adverb ('soaked overnight').

cornflour.note: British-English term for cornstarch -- confirmed by the corpus's own 'corn starch/cornflour' example.

kidney.note: Organ meat -- 'kidney beans' does NOT land here (its head is already 'bean' via the plain non-part-word algorithm, unaffected).

pinchsalt.note: Glued-word artifact, same class as onionchopped.

cupsugar.note: Glued-word artifact, same class as onionchopped.
